title: Product run re-pointed the framework repo git remote (connect_remote walked up to the parent repo)
body: A generated-product run mutated the FRAMEWORK repo git remote. products/MyToDo is not its own git repo (no .git), so run_pipeline -> repo_setup.setup -> VCSManager(products/MyToDo).connect_remote(url) walked UP to the nearest .git (the PF clone) and set origin=https://github.com/srinikc/MyToDo on the framework repo. Observed: git remote -v in the PF clone showed origin=MyToDo; every subsequent fetch/push/ID-CAS went to the product repo; restored manually. Risk: silent pushes to the wrong repo (data loss / leakage).

rcca.root_cause: repo_setup.setup() calls VCSManager(project_dir).connect_remote() without ensuring project_dir is its OWN git repo; when the product dir has no .git, VCSManager discovers the nearest ancestor .git (the framework repo) and rewrites ITS origin. No guard prevents operating on an ancestor repo.
rcca.corrective: Ensure the product dir is initialized as its own git repo before connecting the remote, and add a fail-closed guard so connect_remote never mutates a repo whose root is not the target dir.
rcca.preventive: Test: a product dir without .git is isolated (own repo) and the framework repo remote is unchanged; connect_remote on a non-dedicated repo is refused.
